claims.statement: Compare the breadth of similar tools and their common features, strengths, and weaknesses.
Ground gaps and recommendations in this repository.
Complete the Pro handoff and full Sleuth process, with a review PR.
Keep proposals at personal-project scale and preserve the existing checkout.
Personal narrated review is the leading next job.
Preserve source evidence and repair existing output semantics before another view.
Local lexical retrieval may reduce complete task time more than existing editor Find.
Dictation, annotation, and spatial reconstruction are alternatives, not requested implementation commitments.

shape.appetite: Two narrow repairs and one decision proof; no new service or broad product implementation.
shape.problem: Existing findings can lose meaning in handoff; the next product job and export scope remain undecided.

recommended_shape.expansion_gate: H1 and H2 before detailed search/export architecture
recommended_shape.source_of_truth: Raw media/context/transcript remain original; marks.jsonl permits intentional notes and review edits. Preserve unknown captured fields.
recommended_shape.simpler_counterproposal: O1 current app plus editor Find; O2 manual specialist derivatives
recommended_shape.reuse: One AVPlayer; existing SessionModel, MarkText, Review, subprocess, and local PGM
recommended_shape.valid_intermediate_state: Faithful read/copy output without new search
recommended_shape.rollback: Revert each repair independently; preserve native review and raw session files

success_moves: Prove one synthetic note and source time across existing outputs before adding a view.
Use a semantic answer key instead of a cross-language rendering framework.
Inject processor failures locally; confirm one real synthetic run only when required.
Compare complete task effort against existing review plus editor Find.
Gate export architecture on recipient and included-content policy.
Retain raw evidence and the chronological path; reject broader infrastructure without a distinct task.

first_proof.question: Can an existing reviewed finding survive portable read and copy without losing its meaning?
first_proof.artifact: One synthetic session, fixed answer key, native/processor Markdown, and HTML read/copy evidence
first_proof.decision_rule: Require all note/provenance/time fields and unchanged originals. Keep the narrow repair; reject a new rendering framework.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Research branch; app source unchanged from baseline. Only research and planning files added.
deployment_surfaces: Local macOS app and Chrome extension; no deployment in this run

dependencies.name: Recorded media and speech
proof_rungs: Real local synthetic media when required

first_proof_role.rationale: Output meaning can be checked without recording or speech recognition.

dependencies.local_proof: Fixed answer key with short adjacent sentences, note, crop, and review origin.
dependencies.live_proof: Later isolated Mac review confirms decoding and permissions only when used. No current runtime proof.
dependencies.rollout: Keep originals and chronological review; no model replacement.

dependencies.name: Local processor subprocess

first_proof_role.rationale: First output fixture uses cached data; processing is a separate milestone.

dependencies.local_proof: Inject named outcomes and verify labels, raw hashes, and one retry.
dependencies.live_proof: Use actual installed ffmpeg/parakeet only with synthetic media in later authorized work.
dependencies.rollout: Retain process.log and manual rerun; no queue service.

dependencies.name: Local PGM export
proof_rungs: Local PGM smoke only if payload changes

first_proof_role.rationale: Read/copy parity does not need a PGM service.

dependencies.local_proof: Inspect selected-two-of-five inventory with per-surface canaries.
dependencies.live_proof: Later disposable local PGM project confirms preserved user title/status/images; no cloud proof required.
dependencies.rollout: Current manual Markdown remains usable; export design waits for H2.

fast_local_loop.failure_injection: Temporary process PATH plus malformed/cached/silent data variants
fast_local_loop.slower_confirmation: Isolated native/browser review of synthetic output; real processor only when changed

milestones.title: A reviewed finding survives portable handoff
milestones.outcome: Same note, review origin, and exact source sentence survive native, processor, and HTML read/copy.
milestones.proof: Synthetic semantic contract plus isolated browser observation; raw hashes unchanged. UNRUN.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Existing capture and native review remain; portable output is faithful without search.
milestones.rollback: Revert output repair; retain native Markdown and originals.

milestones.title: Processing failure has a useful result
milestones.outcome: Unavailable or failed processing is distinct from silence and supports one bounded retry.
milestones.proof: No-audio/cached/missing/nonzero/malformed fixtures; later real synthetic processor run. UNRUN.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Raw capture remains accessible; no search or background service required.
milestones.rollback: Keep process.log and manual reprocessing; revert result presentation.

milestones.title: Decide whether local retrieval earns expansion
milestones.outcome: Select a bounded next proposal or keep current review after H1/H2/H3 and task evidence.
milestones.proof: Six paired full-task comparisons after goal selection; predeclared criteria and selected-content inventory. UNRUN.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Existing review works while decisions or experiment remain unresolved.
milestones.rollback: Discard disposable experiment; use current review and specialists.
